_about: Businesses you buy from. cats/only = what they carry. grades = [lowest, highest] quality they stock. packs = which pack sizes (0 small .. 2 bulk). mult = their price level. vol = how much their prices move. lead 0 = you collect it now, 1 = delivered on their next delivery day. days = delivery weekdays (0 Monday .. 6 Sunday). min = minimum order. fee = delivery charge, waived over free_over. terms = days of credit (0 = pay when you order). trip = cost of driving there (lead 0). seasonal = only sells produce that is in season.

suppliers.name: Pronto Cash & Carry
suppliers.desc: Walk in, load the van, pay at the till. Small packs, basic and standard grades, and you pay for the convenience.

suppliers.name: Kiln & Carton Co.
suppliers.desc: Pizza boxes by the bundle and kiln-dried logs by the crate.

suppliers.name: Harbour Foodservice
suppliers.desc: The big lorry. Catering packs of nearly everything, value to quality grade. Order by close, delivered next morning, invoiced weekly.

suppliers.name: Greenway Fruit & Veg
suppliers.desc: Market trader. Fresh produce at market prices: cheap in season, dear out of it, different every day.

suppliers.name: Whitfield & Sons Butchers
suppliers.desc: Cured and cooked meats sliced to order. Standard to premium.

suppliers.name: Meadow Lane Dairy
suppliers.desc: Fresh cheese three times a week and Saturdays. Better mozzarella than the wholesaler, but it does not keep as long.

suppliers.name: Old Mill Flour Co.
suppliers.desc: Flour by the sack, milled to order. Delivers Monday and Thursday.

suppliers.name: Quayside Fish
suppliers.desc: Seafood at the day's landing price. Tuesday to Saturday.

suppliers.name: Fratelli Carbone Importers
suppliers.desc: The real thing, straight off the boat: San Marzano, buffalo mozzarella, Parma ham. Tuesday and Friday only, big minimum, two weeks to pay.

suppliers.name: Tenuta Verde Growers
suppliers.desc: Small growers and cheesemakers. The best there is, picked to order, and only what is in season. Wednesday and Saturday.
